title: SG-1.2.1 · Add the zustand dependency to the frontend package.json and lockfile
summary: Declare zustand as a runtime dependency of game/frontend and record it in package-lock.json.
description: Context: game/frontend/package.json lists react, motion, lucide-react and radix packages but no zustand, and node_modules/zustand is absent. Desired behavior: zustand is a declared runtime dependency and package-lock.json resolves it. Expected result: `import { create } from 'zustand'` resolves in the frontend. Why: the Zustand UI store in SG-1.2 needs it.
acceptance_criteria: Given game/frontend/package.json, when parsed, then dependencies.zustand is a semver range string
Given package-lock.json, when parsed, then packages[''].dependencies.zustand equals the package.json range and packages['node_modules/zustand'] exists with a version
Given the frontend, when 'zustand' is imported, then create is a function
technical_constraints: Use npm so the lockfile stays lockfileVersion 3
zustand goes in dependencies, not devDependencies
definition_of_done: Unit test for the dependency passes
